item.title: VIDEO | Is a new era of success on the horizon for Liverpool City Region?
item.description: With an integrated settlement due to land in April, increasing inward investment, and a growing pipeline of potentially transformative projects to deliver, now is the time for the city region to hit the accelerator, according to participants at a roundtable discussion hosted by Robertson Group. The post VIDEO | Is a new era of success on the horizon for Liverpool City Region? appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Before and after: Heywood Civic’s £5.5m transformation
item.description: Friday saw the reopening of the venue, more than a year after it was shuttered for a much-needed refresh by Rochdale Development Agency, the council-controlled investment company. The post Before and after: Heywood Civic’s £5.5m transformation appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Work starts on 720 Carlisle residences
item.description: Persimmon Homes Lancashire has commenced delivering a mixture of apartments, bungalows, and houses on 81 acres off Wigton Road in Morton, a suburb of the Cumbrian city. The post Work starts on 720 Carlisle residences appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Krol Corlett to build £6.1m Liverpool children’s hospice
item.description: Work will start this month on Zoe’s Place’s new home at Hayman’s Green in West Derby, which will feature a refurbished 4,500 sq ft villa with a 6,700 sq ft extension. The post Krol Corlett to build £6.1m Liverpool children’s hospice appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: RG Group wraps up Round Hill’s Manchester BTR
item.description: Fairfax, a 488-apartment development in Piccadilly East, was delivered in partnership with Olympian Homes. The post RG Group wraps up Round Hill’s Manchester BTR appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Tameside to reconsider 2,150-home Godley Green
item.description: The garden village, one of the area’s largest housing allocations in Places for Everyone, will return to the council’s planning committee on 18 March after a letter of complaint was filed over councillors’ decision to reject the scheme in January. The post Tameside to reconsider 2,150-home Godley Green appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: NHS appoints 10 firms for £37bn hospital programme
item.description: Eleven new healthcare facilities will be delivered under the Hospital 2.0 Alliance, including Leighton in Cheshire and North Manchester General in Crumpsall. The post NHS appoints 10 firms for £37bn hospital programme appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Spanner in works for ‘too tall’ Parsonage Gardens office scheme
item.description: Historic England has formally objected to Beaconsfield Commercial’s plans to knock down two buildings within the conservation area and build a 14-storey office scheme. The post Spanner in works for ‘too tall’ Parsonage Gardens office scheme appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Manchester buys former garage for £16m to support £550m regen
item.description: The city council's acquisition of the Williams showroom on Upper Brook Street is aimed at ensuring the plot’s regeneration goes ahead as planned. The post Manchester buys former garage for £16m to support £550m regen appeared first on Place North West.
